schema_note: A minimal record for a Tesseract fine-tune, defined in release/README.md (R6). Counts, ids, hashes, licences and attribution only: no label text, no local paths.

engine.name: tesseract
engine.build: built on the training pod from the upstream tag 5.5.3

o1.kind: synthetic office-document line and cell crops
o1.text: Reshumot born-digital line text (pool_train, PD-IL) with generated numbers
o1.faces_note: all SIL OFL 1.1; no proprietary or Microsoft face; Tinos only in office_val

anchor.kind: Reshumot lines rendered from born-digital PDFs
anchor.licence: PD-IL (Copyright Act 2007 s. 6); status outside Israel not asserted
anchor.labels: the publisher's PDF text layer, verified within each line

anchor_degraded.kind: anchor lines, upsampled x2, skewed up to 1 degree and degraded by O1's photometric models

olb.kind: scanned Reshumot lines, Open Law Book labels
olb.label_licence: CC BY-SA 4.0, Hebrew Wikisource contributors, ספר החוקים הפתוח
olb.decision: heocr-engine decision 0016: weights stay Apache-2.0 with this credit; no word list built

removed: exact hits on D-bench text pool and hash fixtures
word 6-grams in any S17a decontamination pool

decontamination.check: eval's official check_train_overlap (word 6-grams after folding, every target, restricted ones included); a list counts as clean only on eval's own run
decontamination.first_run: NOT CLEAN: 5,507 paths dropped (o1 2,683, anchor 730, degraded anchor 559, olb 1,535)
decontamination.final: CLEAN, 0 hits on every target (2026-11-18, unit office_clean_v2b)

not_encodable_by_starter.note: Latin letters, □ or ”; lstmtraining skips them

outcome.selection_rule: lowest line_fold_v1 CER on office_val_sel; ties earlier

selection_set.name: office_val_sel
selection_set.note: Tinos, held-out booklets; drawn from the training distribution

evaluation.note: aggregates only; no office-case text or image
